hypotheses.text: A replayed chunk past its deadline is refused DEADLINE_EXPIRED before WRONG_STATE, so chunkRefusal must look the operation up for DEADLINE_EXPIRED and ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED too. Testable: a settled chunk replayed 121 s after its reservation is closed, an in-flight one held, and the run is not stopped by a closed chunk.

note: Owner accepted B45-001 on 2026-10-12. New from its review: B51. Open: B40, B46, B51.
